caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular patch with rounded corners placed in the center of a plain, beige background. The patch features a dark green background with three stylized flowers. The largest flower, positioned towards the top center, has bright red petals with cream-colored tips and a central stem that extends downward. To the left, a smaller flower has similar red petals but with more visible cream accents and a yellow center. On the right, another small bud, also red, is attached to a curved stem. The flowers are connected by thin, yellow-brown stems, and there are a few yellow-brown leaves with simple shapes. The edges of the green patch are irregular and appear worn. The composition is balanced within the patch, and the entire patch is set against a featureless light brown or beige background.
title: Piece of Crewel Embroidery
